newsitem.title: USA: Seagate, Gateway stocks drop on earnings warnings.
newsitem.headline: Seagate, Gateway stocks drop on earnings warnings.

text.p: The stocks of Seagate Technology Inc. and Gateway 2000 Inc. fell sharply Wednesday, one day after they warned that their quarterly results would fall short of Wall Street's expectations.

Seagate, a maker of computer disk drives, tumbled $5.375, or nearly 13 percent, to $36, and Gateway, a maker of personal computers, was off more than 8 percent, down $2.875 at $31.875, both on the New York Stock Exchange.
Scotts Valley, Calif.-based Seagate reported after Tuesday's stock market close that its sales were short of its target for the latest quarter. The company plans to release its results on July 9.
Gateway 2000 said Tuesday it expected revenues for the second quarter to be about flat with the first quarter's revenues of $1.42 billion.
The two companies blamed the downbeat results on lackluster demand for their products.
